data_fields.name: side_threshold_draw
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.4 (mismatch; fixed to one value in sketch)

data_fields.name: health_flash_fade
data_fields.donor_constant: FADE_TIME 100 at 20 per second of frame delta (about 5 s)

best_idea: Mark each hit as a fading cue on the side it came from, stored in world space and projected onto the current view every frame, with max-per-side so three attackers stay readable.
decision_why: Frankendom needs where-did-that-come-from for up to three attackers; keep the four-side cue and 50-unit on-top rule, fix the stale direction, the two thresholds, the snap-off and the cleared-on-no-source defect, and follow the world camera yaw.
acceptance: At 375 wide in a zone fight, a hit from the player's right lights a cue on the right edge that fades to nothing over about 0.5 s and stays on the attacker's side as the player turns; with three attackers at front, left and rear, three cues show together; a server test asserts the hit event carries the attacker's position.
